class.name: GameStateManager
class.brief_description: Manager that maintains a stack of `GameState` nodes and coordinates state transitions (push, pop, change) and per-frame updates.
class.description:
`GameStateManager` simplifies scene-based state management by keeping a stack of active `GameState` instances. States may be pushed by filename, preloaded `PackedScene`, or an existing `GameState` object. The manager handles instantiation, parenting, and lifecycle callbacks (`_on_enter`, `_on_exit`, `_on_update`).
Methods with a `_fast` suffix accept a `PackedScene` directly and avoid performing a ResourceLoader lookup; use them when you have a preloaded scene for better performance.

method.name: change_state
method.description: Pop the current top state (if any) and push the provided state. The argument may be a filename (String), a `PackedScene`, or an instantiated `GameState` object.

method.name: change_state_fast
method.description: Change the current state by popping the top state and pushing the provided `PackedScene` instance. Use when you already have a preloaded `PackedScene`.

method.name: clear_stack
method.description: Remove and free all states from the stack immediately.

method.name: get_stack_size
method.description: Return the current number of states on the stack.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Return `true` when there are no states on the stack.

method.name: pop_state
method.description: Pop and free the top-most state. If the stack is empty this is a no-op.

method.name: pop_this_state
method.description: Pop states repeatedly until the current depth frame is cleared. Typically used to unwind multiple pushed states back to a previous point.

method.name: push_state
method.description: Push a new state onto the stack. The argument may be a filename (String), a `PackedScene`, or an existing `GameState` instance. When given a filename, the resource is loaded via `ResourceLoader`.

method.name: push_state_fast
method.description: Instantiate and push the provided `PackedScene` as a new `GameState`. Use this variant when you already have a preloaded `PackedScene` to avoid a second resource lookup.

member.name: expected_stack_depth
member.description: Reserved amount of stack space to pre-allocate for performance. Adjust if you expect deeper or shallower state stacks.
